newsitem.title: USA: NGPL takes bids for new La. gas capacity.
newsitem.headline: NGPL takes bids for new La. gas capacity.

text.p: Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America is holding a 30-day open season to assess market needs for additional capacity on its Louisiana system, the company said in a news release.

From 0800 CST Tuesday, Feb 25, to 1600 CST Wednesday, March 26, NGPL will take shippers' fixed-priced bids for firm transportation service to East Coast pipelines and the Henry Hub via the Louisiana line.
If a sufficient number of bids are collected, NGPL said it will file for the necessary authorizations to construct new pipeline.
The new capacity for markets in southern Louisiana and to pipelines serving the East Coast would then be in service by December, 1998.
The existing line currently runs from NGPL's compressor station 302 in New Caney, Texas, to the Henry Hub, La.
NGPL is a subsidiary of Midcon Corp, which is a unit of Occidental Petroleum Corp.
